messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: p99 latency breach observed on router service (eu-west-1). p95=820ms, p99=2.7s (SLO p99 <= 1.2s). Streaming stalls: ~1.2k streams stalled in last 5m. Paging on-call: @elaine

elaine: I'm oncall — ack. samir, can you pull router routing policy rollout history? maria, any customer reports?

samir: looking at control-plane. recent rollout: 'split-by-weight-v2' deployed to eu-west-1 at 05:10UTC, currently at 40% traffic. checking shard load and affinity.

maria: CS picked up multiple tickets from Acme and Brightly around 05:12UTC — reconnects + partial audio stalls for EU users. Marking as P1 customer-impacting.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout split-by-weight-v2 started 2026-03-15T05:10:14Z -> rollout_percent=40 -> triggered-by=canary-pipeline-42

jorge: quick theory: the new LB policy seems to favor locality and ended up steering many heavy streaming sessions to a small set of shards (hot partition). that would explain tail blowups and streaming stalls.

samir: corroborating: control-plane metrics show shard affinity entropy dropped sharply after rollout. some shards at ~95% CPU, others idle. ran a quick query: 
```
# ad-hoc shard QPS snapshot (sample)
shard-17: 1287 r/s
shard-03: 1123 r/s
shard-09: 45 r/s
shard-12: 32 r/s
```
these top shards coincide with elevated latency and OOM backpressure traces.

elaine: ok — we need mitigation path: 1) rollback the rollout to 0% in eu-west-1, 2) trigger hotshard eject on the overloaded workers, 3) enable eager fallback to smaller model variant for streaming sessions temporarily.

maria: CS: notifying Acme with a short message — "we're investigating routing-induced streaming degradation in EU, mitigation in progress" — will update when mitigated.

samir: executing rollback now. `kubectl patch rollout split-by-weight-v2 -n router --patch '{"spec": {"percentage": 0}}'`

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback request received for split-by-weight-v2 -> initiating canary cancel in eu-west-1

samir: forced ejection of shard-17 from router pool: `routerctl eject --shard shard-17 --reason hot-partition` — rebalancer will redistribute connections. also increased routing fanout to 6 for streaming flows to reduce per-shard pressure.

jorge: FYI the policy had an edge-case: when session-affinity TTL < 60s + prefer-local enabled, the hash function ended up collapsing keys into 3/20 shards for long-running streaming sessions. filing bug: RB-1179 (routing-policy: prefer-local + short-ttl -> skew).

elaine: monitoring telemetry: p99 dropped to 1.4s within 90s of rollback, stalled streams down to ~220 in last 5m. still above SLO but improving.

samir: quick health check command for ops: `curl -s https://router-eu-west1.internal/healthz | jq .` -> returning all ok; tails still elevated on a few nodes — diffing kernel logs now.

maria: CS update sent to Acme: "Mitigation underway, routing rollback initiated. We'll update in 15 minutes or on resolution."

ops-bot: autoscaler: triggered burst-backed capacity in eu-west-1 (+2 nodes) due to sustained CPU pressure at 06:02UTC.

jorge: while we have momentum: 1) keep rollback until we have a patched policy; 2) run an A/B synthetic to validate even distribution across shards; 3) postmortem owners: samir (infra), jorge (routing), elaine (oncall runbook).

elaine: noted. samir, can you confirm any customer errors (5xx/stream resets) count and whether any persisted logs for Acme?

samir: quick counts: ~1.9k stream resets in 25m window, ~3.1% of EU streaming requests. Acme accounts for ~420 of those resets. saving logs -> S3 prefix s3://redwood-incident-logs/5987654321/

maria: CS will schedule follow-up with Acme success manager once we have full RCA. they want ETA for fix.

elaine: current status: rollback in progress, hotshard ejected, fanout increased, extra capacity added. p99 trending down to 920ms in last 2m. continue monitoring; if p99 < 600ms and stalled streams < 50 for 10m we'll close page.

jorge: opened tracking ticket: INT-2394 "routing policy skew -> hot partitions" with initial notes + reproduction steps. assigning to routing team.

incident-bot: Incident updated: severity=sev2 -> mitigated (partial). next update scheduled in 15m.

samir: follow-ups: implement guard in rollout job to detect shard entropy drop (block rollout if entropy decreases > 20%), add synthetic traffic that exercises long-lived streaming sessions in canary, and patch prefer-local TTL handling.

elaine: thanks team. final quick note for postmortem: customer impact = partial streaming degradations for EU customers, ~3% request error rate, Acme impacted (420 resets). timeline: rollout 05:10UTC -> anomaly detected 05:14UTC -> rollback initiated 05:16UTC -> p99 recovery to ~920ms by 05:18UTC.

maria: I'll prepare CS timeline and share with engineering for RCA. closing updates once RCA available. :white_check_mark:"
